evidence.title: Model-Consistent Byzantine-Resilient Decentralized Federated Learning for Collaborative Missions

summary: Researchers introduce a new model-consistent approach to decentralized federated learning that enhances resilience against Byzantine attacks in collaborative AI missions. The method aims to improve robustness and reliability in distributed AI systems.
title: Advancements in Byzantine-Resilient Decentralized Federated Learning for AI Collaboration
